text: MLB owners approved Denver and South Florida as expansion franchises on July 5, 1991; the shared expansion fee was reported as $190 million.
Colorado and Florida selected players in the 1992 MLB Expansion Draft before beginning play in 1993.
Colorado played its first regular-season game April 5, 1993 and its first home game April 9 before 80,227.
Florida played its first game April 5, 1993 before 42,334 at Joe Robbie Stadium and finished 64-98.
MLB owners formally welcomed Tampa Bay and Arizona as expansion teams on March 9, 1995 by a 28-0 vote.
Tampa Bay selected 35 players in the November 18, 1997 MLB Expansion Draft.
Tampa Bay played its first regular-season game March 31, 1998 before 45,369 at Tropicana Field.
Arizona played its first regular-season game March 31, 1998 before 50,179 at Bank One Ballpark.
